tasks.label: Build
tasks.command: build_type="${input:buildType}"; build_target="${input:buildTarget}"; build_types=(debug release); build_targets=(gui headless); if [[ "$build_type" != all ]]; then build_types=("$build_type"); fi; if [[ "$build_target" != all ]]; then build_targets=("$build_target"); fi; for type in "${build_types[@]}"; do for target in "${build_targets[@]}"; do preset="${type}-${target}"; cmake --preset "$preset" && cmake --build --preset "$preset" || exit $?; done; done

tasks.label: Clean
tasks.command: build_type="${input:buildType}"; build_target="${input:buildTarget}"; build_types=(debug release); build_targets=(gui headless); if [[ "$build_type" != all ]]; then build_types=("$build_type"); fi; if [[ "$build_target" != all ]]; then build_targets=("$build_target"); fi; for type in "${build_types[@]}"; do for target in "${build_targets[@]}"; do build_dir="build/${type}-${target}"; if [[ -d "$build_dir" ]]; then cmake -E rm -rf "$build_dir" || exit $?; fi; done; done
